Visitor returns rendered template as a bare string (not a dict) and original mixed-case content is preserved end-to-end (regression guard for issue #350)

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitLink(ctx: any, href: any, text: any, title: any): string | { type: "custom"; output: string } {
        return `[${text}](https://new-cdn.com/file.pdf)`;
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<a href=\"https://old-cdn.com/file.pdf\">Download</a>", { visitor: _testVisitor as any });
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
